scripts.build: wrangler types && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply bc_content --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply bc_learning --local
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run content:build && npm run content:authored && wrangler d1 execute bc_content --local --file seed/curriculum.sql && wrangler d1 execute bc_content --local --file seed/authored.sql
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply bc_content --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply bc_learning --remote
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run content:build && npm run content:authored && wrangler d1 execute bc_content --remote --file seed/curriculum.sql && wrangler d1 execute bc_content --remote --file seed/authored.sql
scripts.e2e:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state && wrangler d1 migrations apply bc_content --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state && wrangler d1 migrations apply bc_learning --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state && wrangler d1 execute bc_content --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --file seed/content_sample.sql
